channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Supreme Court chief justice allows construction on White House ballroom to continue
item.description: Chief Justice John Roberts issued an administrative stay of a lower court order.

item.title: Watch Live: Lindsay Clancy trial defense rests, prosecution calls new witnesses
item.description: The defense rested in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial Friday in Massachusetts. The prosecution has started calling rebuttal witnesses.

item.title: Heroic goose alerts family to barn fire
item.description: A goose named Goosey was caught on camera warning its family about a fire in their barn overnight.

item.title: Woman secretly filmed by Meta glasses raises privacy alarm
item.description: A woman who was covertly filmed says AI-powered smart glasses like Meta's threaten personal privacy.
